hook: Did you know the UN Environment Programme is restoring 252 million hectares, an area like Kazakhstan?

sections.voiceover: Did you know the UN Environment Programme is restoring 252 million hectares, an area like Kazakhstan?
sections.visual_cue: Satellite view of Kazakhstan map overlaying a vibrant green forest landscape.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle wind chime and forest ambient sound.

sections.voiceover: They released this massive restoration data in Yerevan on 29 October 2026. Can 149 countries actually succeed in restoring these vital natural ecosystems?
sections.visual_cue: United Nations Environment Programme logo on a clean white background.

sections.voiceover: These United Nations Environment Programme projects aren't just restoring land; they're creating over one million jobs.

sections.voiceover: Restoration projects in 149 countries are now actively rebuilding vital natural habitats for our planet.

sections.voiceover: Nature is making a comeback across 252 million hectares.
